forbiddenOutcome.description: A machine reads txHash from an unmapped FlowPulse pointer before reader-attached receipt metadata exists.

invariant: Receipt-only fields cannot be dereferenced before a FlowPulse pointer is mapped by reader-attached evidence.
title: pre-receipt txHash read
whyFlowPulseMatters: txHash is a receipt fact. The hook cannot know it during execution, so the runtime must fault until a reader maps the FlowPulse receipt page.
